note: Small private campground and marina on the backwaters of Tippy Dam (Manistee River impoundment) at the mouth of the Pine River near Wellston, surrounded by Manistee National Forest: primitive sites with fire rings and picnic tables, hand-pump wells, boat slips and a launch. Weekend and weekly camp-and-rowboat specials. --Claude
summary: Operator's 2026 rate page confirms $30 a night per unit (camping only; $50 with launch/dock), monthly $450, seasonal $950. Corrected hookups: the campground is '11 primitive sites' with hand-pump wells, so water/sewer true -> false and electric 0 (the note's 'full-hookup RV sites' was wrong); added 11 sites, potable water, phone reservations. Note rewritten without the wrong full-hookup and fuel-dock claims and the booking text.
flags: Criteria: the operator describes 11 PRIMITIVE sites (fire ring, picnic table, two hand-pump wells on the property), no hookups; the inclusion evidence and note claimed full-hookup RV sites. The page does not say whether the sites take RVs or how long ('Camping per unit'), so a 23-ft motorhome fit is unconfirmed - call 231-878-0989.
Phone: the entry has 231-848-7449; the operator's site (home and contact pages) gives (231) 878-0989 (host Steve Bussell), 19522 Husiar Rd, Wellston.
Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator places the campgrounds 'on the Backwaters of Tippy Dam' with the record walleye 'caught right here in front of Loomis Landing'; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
Long-stay: sites sell nightly, weekly, monthly ($450) and seasonal ($950); the seasonal share of the 11 sites is not stated. A nightly rate is posted, so test 2 passes.
